entries.56.1: परवीरहा slayer of enemy heroes, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, रामस्य of Rama, भाषितम् the speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, दीप्ततेजसम् of blazing splendour, राघवम् to Raghava, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke
entries.56.2: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, निक्षिप्तदेहौ having laid aside their bodies, देवसम्मतौ honoured by the gods, तौ those two, द्विजपार्थिवौ the brahmin and the king, पुनः again, देहेन with a body, संयोगम् union, कथम् how, जग्मतुः did they attain
entries.56.3: लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, एवम् thus, उक्तः तु addressed, महातेजाः of great splendour, पुरुषर्षभः bull among men, इक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः delight of the Ikshvakus, रामश्च Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, प्रत्युवाच replied
entries.56.4: धार्मिकौ the righteous pair, तौ those two, परस्परशापेन by their mutual curse, देहौ their bodies, उत्सृज्य having cast off, तपोधनौ rich in austerity, वायुभूतौ become as the wind, नृपविप्रर्षी the royal sage and the brahmin sage, अभूताम् became
entries.56.5: अशरीरः bodiless, सुमहातेजाः of exceedingly great splendour, महामुनिः the great sage, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, अन्यस्य of another, शरीरस्य body, कृते for the sake, पितुः of his father, अन्तिकम् to the presence, जगाम went
entries.56.6: धर्मवित् the knower of dharma, वायुभूतः become as the wind, सः he, ततः then, देवदेवस्य of the god of gods, पादौ the feet, अभिवाद्य having saluted, अथ then, पितामहम् to the Grandsire, इदम् this, वचः word, उवाच spoke
entries.56.7: भगवन् O venerable one, निमिशापेन by the curse of Nimi, विदेहत्वम् bodilessness, उपागमम् I have come to, लोकनाथ O lord of the worlds, महादेव O great god, त्वम् you, अण्डजः अपि though born of the egg, अब्जजः are lotus-born
entries.56.8: प्रभो O lord, देहहीनानाम् for those bereft of body, सर्वेषाम् for all, महत् great, दुःखम् sorrow, भविष्यति shall be, हीनदेहस्य वै of one without a body indeed, सर्वकार्याणि all rites, लुप्यन्ते are lost, अन्यस्य of another, देहस्य body, सद्भावे in the bestowing, प्रसादम् favour, कर्तुम् to show, अर्हसि you ought
entries.56.9: ततः then, अमितप्रभः of measureless lustre, स्वयम्भूः the self-born, ब्रह्मा Brahma, तम् to him, उवाच said, महायशः O greatly renowned one, त्वम् you, मित्रावरुणजम् sprung from Mitra and Varuna, तेजः the essence, प्रविश enter
entries.56.10: द्विजसत्तम O best of the twice-born, तत्र अपि there too, त्वम् you, अयोनिजः not born of a womb, भविता shall be, महता by great, धर्मेण righteousness, युक्तः endowed, पुनः again, मे my, वशम् sway, एष्यसि you shall come to
entries.56.11: देवेन by the god, एवम् thus, उक्तः तु addressed, अभिवाद्य च and having saluted, पितामहम् the Grandsire, प्रदक्षिणम् the rightward circling, कृत्वा having made, तूर्णम् swiftly, वरुणालयम् to the abode of Varuna, प्रययौ went
entries.56.12: तमेव कालम् at that very time, मित्रः अपि Mitra too, क्षीरोदेन सह along with the ocean of milk, उपेतः joined, सुरोत्तमैः by the best of the gods, पूज्यमानः being honoured, वरुणत्वम् the office of Varuna, अकारयत् discharged
entries.56.13: एतस्मिन् एव काले तु at this very time, परमाप्सराः the foremost of apsaras, उर्वशी Urvashi, सखिभिः by her companions, वृता attended, यदृच्छया by chance, तम् that, उद्देशम् place, आययौ came to
entries.56.14: वरुणालये in the abode of Varuna, क्रीडन्तीम् sporting, रूपसम्पन्नाम् endowed with beauty, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा having seen, उर्वशीकृते on account of Urvashi, वरुणं च upon Varuna, परमः the utmost, हर्षः joy, आविशत् came
entries.56.15: सः he, वरुणः Varuna, पद्मपलाशाक्षीम् her eyes like lotus petals, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् her face like the full moon, ताम् that, अप्सरोवराम् best of apsaras, मैथुनाय for union, वरयामास sought
entries.56.16: ततः then, सा तु and she, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, स्थिता standing, वरुणम् to Varuna, प्रत्युवाच replied, सुरेश्वर O lord of the gods, अहम् I, पूर्वम् एव already before this, मित्रेण by Mitra, साक्षात् in person, वृता have been chosen
entries.56.17: वरुणः तु and Varuna, कन्दर्पशरपीडितः tormented by the arrows of Kandarpa, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, देवनिर्मिते fashioned by the gods, अस्मिन् in this, कुम्भे jar, इदम् this, तेजः seed, समुत्स्रक्ष्ये I shall pour forth
entries.56.18: सुश्रोणि O fair-hipped one, वरवर्णिनि O lady of lovely hue, यदि if, सङ्गमम् union, न इच्छसि you do not desire, एवम् thus, त्वयि upon you, उत्सृज्य having poured it forth, अहम् I, कृतकामः my desire fulfilled, भविष्यामि shall become
entries.56.19: उर्वशी Urvashi, तस्य of that, लोकपालस्य guardian of the world, वरुणस्य of Varuna, तत् that, सुभाषितम् well-spoken, वाक्यम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, परमप्रीता greatly pleased, उवाच ह said
entries.56.20: प्रभो O lord, कामम् assuredly, एतत् this, एवम् so, भवतु let it be, मे my, हृदयम् heart, त्वयि upon you, स्थितम् rests, तुभ्यम् toward you, भावश्चापि and my inclination too, अधिकः is the greater, देहः तु but my body, मित्रस्य is Mitra's
entries.56.21: उर्वश्या by Urvashi, एवम् thus, उक्तः तु addressed, तत् that, महत् great, अद्भुतम् wondrous, ज्वलदग्निशिखाप्रख्यम् like a blazing tongue of fire, रेतः seed, तस्मिन् in that, कुम्भे हि jar indeed, अपासृजत् he released
entries.56.22: उर्वशी तु and Urvashi, तत्र thither, अगमत् went, यत्र where, मित्रः वै Mitra indeed, देवता the god, तां तु and her, मित्रः Mitra, सुसङ्क्रम्य having drawn near, उर्वशीम् to Urvashi, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said
entries.56.23: मया by me, पूर्वम् formerly, निमन्त्रिता you were bespoken, कस्मात् why, त्वम् you, अवसर्जिता have let that go, अन्यम् another, पतिम् lord, वृतवती you have chosen, तस्मात् therefore, त्वम् you, दुष्टचारिणी are of corrupt conduct
entries.56.24: अनेन by this, दुष्कृतेन misdeed, मत्क्रोधकलुषीकृता sullied by my wrath, त्वम् you, मनुष्यलोकम् the world of men, आस्थाय having resorted to, कञ्चित् some, कालम् time, निवत्स्यसि shall dwell there
entries.56.25: दुर्बुद्धे O evil-minded one, बुधस्य of Budha, पुत्रः the son, राजर्षिः the royal sage, काशीराजः king of Kashi, पुरूरवाः Pururavas, तम् to him, अद्य today, गच्छ go, सः he, ते your, भर्ता husband, भविष्यति shall be
entries.56.26: ततः then, सा she, शापदोषेण by the taint of the curse, पुरूरवसम् to Pururavas, अभ्यगात् went, प्रतियाते having proceeded, बुधस्य of Budha, औरसम् true-born, आत्मजम् son, पुरूरवम् Pururavas
entries.56.27: ततः then, तस्य to him, श्रीमान् the illustrious, महाबलः the mighty, आयुः Ayu, पुत्रः as son, जज्ञे was born, यस्य whose, पुत्रः तु son indeed, इन्द्रसमद्युतिः equal in radiance to Indra, नहुषः Nahusha, बभूव was
entries.56.28: वृत्राय upon Vritra, वज्रम् the thunderbolt, उत्सृज्य having loosed, अथ then, त्रिदिवेश्वरे when the lord of heaven, भ्रान्ते had strayed, येन by whom, शतम् a hundred, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, इन्द्रत्वम् the office of Indra, प्रशासितम् was administered
entries.56.29: चारुदती of fair teeth, सुनेत्रा of lovely eyes, सा she, उर्वशी Urvashi, तदा then, तेन by that, शापेन curse, भूमिम् to the earth, जगाम went, सुभ्रूः the fair-browed one, बहूनि many, वर्षाणि years, अवसच्च and dwelt there, शापक्षयात् at the wearing out of the curse, इन्द्रसदः to the hall of Indra, ययौ च and went
entries.57.1: दिव्यसङ्काशाम् resembling a tale of heaven, अद्भुतदर्शनाम् wondrous to behold, ताम् that, कथाम् story, श्रुत्वा having heard, परमप्रीतः greatly pleased, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, राघवम् to Raghava, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.57.2: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, निक्षिप्तदेहौ having laid aside their bodies, देवसम्मतौ honoured by the gods, तौ those two, द्विजपार्थिवौ the brahmin and the king, पुनः again, देहेन with a body, संयोगम् union, कथम् how, जग्मुः did they attain
entries.57.3: सत्यपराक्रमः of true valour, रामः Rama, तस्य his, तत् that, भाषितम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, महात्मनः of the great-souled, वसिष्ठस्य Vasishtha, ताम् that, कथाम् tale, कथयामास related
entries.57.4: रघुश्रेष्ठ O best of the Raghus, महात्मनोः of the two great-souled ones, तेजःपूर्णः filled with their essence, यः कुम्भः the jar which there was, तस्मिन् in it, तेजोमयौ formed of that essence, ऋषिसत्तमौ best of sages, विप्रौ the two brahmins, सम्भूतौ came into being
entries.57.5: तत्र there, पूर्वम् first, भगवान् the venerable, ऋषिः sage, अगस्त्यः Agastya, समभवत् हि did indeed come forth, अहम् I, तव your, सुतः न am not your son, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, मित्रम् from Mitra, तस्मात् from him, अपाक्रमत् he departed
entries.57.6: उर्वस्याः for Urvashi, मित्रस्य of Mitra, पूर्वम् formerly, आहितम् deposited, तत् that, तेजः तु seed indeed, तस्मिन् in that, कुम्भे jar, समभवत् came to be, यत्र where, वारुणम् of Varuna, तत् that, तेजः seed
entries.57.7: अथ then, कस्यचित् after some, कालस्य तु time, मित्रावरुणसम्भवः sprung from Mitra and Varuna, तेजसा with splendour, युक्तः endowed, इक्ष्वाकुदैवतम् tutelary of the Ikshvakus, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, जज्ञे was born
entries.57.8: सौम्य O gentle one, महातेजाः of great splendour, इक्ष्वाकुः Ikshvaku, जातमात्रम् newly born, अनिन्दितम् the blameless one, तम् him, नः our, अस्य this, वंशस्य of the line, भवाय for the prosperity, पुरोधसम् as family priest, वव्रे chose
entries.57.9: सौम्य O gentle one, एवम् thus, अपूर्वदेहस्य of him whose body was unlike any before, महात्मनः the great-souled, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasishtha, निर्गमः the coming forth, कथितः has been told, निमेः of Nimi, यथा how it, अभवत् came about, शृणु hear
entries.57.10: ते they, सर्वे एव all, मनीषिणः the wise, ऋषयः sages, विदेहम् bodiless, राजानम् the king, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तं च him, यागदीक्षाम् the consecration for the sacrifice, योजयामासुः caused to undertake
entries.57.11: ततः then, द्विजोत्तमाः the best of the twice-born, पौरभृत्यसमन्विताः together with the townsfolk and the servants, गन्धैः with fragrances, माल्यैश्च and garlands, वस्त्रैश्च and garments, नरेन्द्रस्य of the lord of men, तं च that, देहम् body, रक्षन्ति स्म guarded
entries.57.12: ततः then, यज्ञे when the sacrifice, समाप्ते तु was completed, भृगुः Bhrigu, तत्र there, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said, पार्थिव O king, तव with you, तुष्टः अस्मि I am pleased, ते your, चेतः consciousness, आनयिष्यामि I shall bring back
entries.57.13: सुराः the gods, सर्वे all, सुप्रीताश्च and well pleased, निमेः of Nimi, चेतः to the consciousness, तथा thus, अब्रुवन् said, राजर्षे O royal sage, वरम् a boon, वरय choose, ते your, चेतः consciousness, क्व where, निरूप्यताम् let it be appointed
entries.57.14: सर्वैः by all, सुरैः the gods, एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, निमेः of Nimi, चेतः the consciousness, तदा then, अब्रवीत् said, सुरसत्तमाः O best of the gods, सर्वभूतानाम् of all beings, नेत्रेषु in the eyes, वसेयम् may I dwell
entries.57.15: विबुधाः the gods, बाढम् इति एव so be it indeed, तदा then, निमेः of Nimi, चेतः to the consciousness, अब्रुवन् said, सर्वभूतानाम् of all beings, नेत्रेषु in the eyes, वायुभूतः as wind, चरिष्यसि you shall move
entries.57.16: पृथिवीपते O lord of the earth, वायुभूतेन as wind, चरता as you move, त्वत्कृते on your account, विश्रमार्थम् for the sake of rest, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, चक्षूंषि the eyes, निमिष्यन्ति shall wink
entries.57.17: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा तु having spoken, सर्वे all, विबुधाः the gods, यथागतम् as they had come, जग्मुः went, महात्मानः the great-souled, ऋषयः अपि sages too, निमेः of Nimi, देहम् the body, समाहरन् took up
entries.57.18: तदा then, महात्मानः the great-souled ones, निमेः of Nimi, पुत्रहेतोः for the sake of a son, तत्र there, अरणिम् the fire-stick, निक्षिप्य having set down, मन्त्रहोमैः with mantras and oblations, ओजसा with vigour, मथनम् the churning, चक्रुः made
entries.57.19: अरण्याम् when the fire-stick, मथ्यामानायाम् was being churned, महातपाः one of great austerity, प्रादुर्भूतः came forth, मथनात् from the churning, मिथिः इति as Mithi, आहुः they call him, जननात् from the being born, जनकः Janaka, अभवत् he became, यस्मात् since, विदेहात् from the bodiless one, सम्भूतः he was produced, ततः thence, वैदेहः तु as Vaideha, स्मृतः he is known
entries.57.20: एवम् thus, विदेहराजश्च and king of Videha, जनकः Janaka, पूर्वकः the first, अभवत् he became, महातेजाः of great splendour, मिथिर्नाम Mithi by name, तेन therefore, अयम् this line, मैथिलः Maithila, अभवत् became
entries.58.1: रामे when Rama, एवम् thus, ब्रुवति तु was speaking, परवीरहा slayer of enemy heroes, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तेजसा with splendour, ज्वलन्तम् इव as though blazing, महात्मानम् the great-souled one, प्रत्युवाच replied to
entries.58.2: राजशार्दूल O tiger among kings, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasishtha, निमेः सह with Nimi, निर्वृत्तम् that came to pass, विदेहस्य of the bodiless one, पुरातनम् of old, महत् a great, अद्भुतम् marvel, आश्चर्यम् a wonder
entries.58.3: निमिः तु and Nimi, क्षत्रियः a kshatriya, शूरः a hero, विशेषेण च and moreover, दीक्षितः consecrated, राजा the king, महात्मनः of the great-souled, वसिष्ठस्य Vasishtha, क्षमाम् forbearance, न कृतवान् did not show
entries.58.4: तेन by him, एवम् thus, उक्तः तु addressed, अयम् this, श्रीमान् illustrious, क्षत्रियपुङ्गवः bull among kshatriyas, सर्वशास्त्रविशारदम् skilled in all the sciences, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke
entries.58.5: रमयताम् among those who give delight, श्रेष्ठः the best, रामः Rama, दीप्ततेजसम् of blazing splendour, भ्रातरम् to his brother, वीर O hero, पुरुषेषु among men, सर्वत्र in every case, क्षमा forbearance, न प्रदृश्यते is not seen
entries.58.6: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, रोषः wrath, दुःसहः is hard to bear, यथा how, ययातिना by Yayati, क्षान्तः it was borne, सत्त्वानुगम् conformable to his nature, पुरस्कृत्य having set foremost, तत् that, समाहितः attentively, निबोध learn
entries.58.7: सौम्य O gentle one, नहुषस्य of Nahusha, सुतः the son, पौरवर्धनः increaser of the Pauravas, ययातिः Yayati, राजा the king, तस्य his, भार्याद्वयम् two wives, रूपेण in beauty, भुवि on earth, अप्रतिमम् beyond compare
entries.58.8: तस्य his, नाहुषस्य son of Nahusha, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, एका तु one indeed, पुरस्कृता was preferred, वृषपर्वणः of Vrishaparvan, दुहिता the daughter, दैतेयी the daitya woman, शर्मिष्ठा नाम Sharmishtha by name
entries.58.9: पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, अन्या तु and the other, ययातेः of Yayati, ऊशनसः of Ushanas, पत्नी the wife, सुमध्यमा of slender waist, देवयानी Devayani, सा she, राज्ञः to the king, न तु दयिता was not the beloved
entries.58.10: तयोः of those two, सम्भूतौ born, रूपवन्तौ comely, समाहितौ well favoured, पुत्रौ तु two sons indeed, तदा then, शर्मिष्ठा Sharmishtha, पूरुम् Puru, देवयानी Devayani, यदुम् Yadu, अजनयत् bore
entries.58.11: पूरुः तु and Puru, गुणैः by his merits, मातृकृतेन च and by his mother's doing, राज्ञः to the king, दयितः was dear, ततः then, दुःखसमाविष्टः overcome with sorrow, यदुः Yadu, मातरम् to his mother, अब्रवीत् said
entries.58.12: अक्लिष्टकर्मणः of untiring deeds, देवस्य of the divine, भार्गवस्य of Bhargava, कुले in the line, जाता born, हृद्गतम् lodged in the heart, दुःखम् sorrow, दुःसहम् unbearable, अवमानं च and slight, सहसे you endure
entries.58.13: देवि O lady, आवां च we two, सहितौ together, हुताशनम् the fire, प्रविशाव let us enter, राजा तु and let the king, दैत्यपुत्र्या with the daitya's daughter, सार्धम् together, बहुक्षपाः for many nights, रमताम् take his pleasure
entries.58.14: यदि वा but if, ते by you, सहनीयम् it is to be borne, माम् me, अनुज्ञातुम् to give leave, अर्हसि you ought, त्वम् you, क्षम forbear, अहम् I, न क्षमिष्ये shall not forbear, मरिष्यामि I shall die, न संशयः there is no doubt
entries.58.15: परमार्तस्य of him utterly stricken, रोदतः weeping, पुत्रस्य of her son, भाषितम् the speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, देवयानी तु and Devayani, सङ्क्रुद्धा greatly enraged, तदा then, पितरम् her father, सस्मार called to mind
entries.58.16: तदा then, भार्गवः Bhargava, दुहितुः of his daughter, तत् that, इङ्गितम् inward sign, अभिज्ञाय having discerned, यत्र where, सा she, देवयानी तु Devayani was, तत्र thither, त्वरितम् swiftly, आगतः came
entries.58.17: अप्रकृतिस्थाम् not in her natural state, अप्रहृष्टाम् unrejoicing, अचेतनाम् bereft of sense, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा च and having seen, पिता the father, दुहितरम् to his daughter, एतत् this, किम् what is, इति thus, वाक्यम् a word, अब्रवीत् च and said
entries.58.18: असकृत् repeatedly, पृच्छन्तम् questioning her, दीप्ततेजसम् of blazing splendour, तं वै that, भार्गवम् Bhargava, देवयानी तु and Devayani, सङ्क्रुद्धा greatly enraged, पितरम् to her father, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.58.19: मुनिसत्तम O best of sages, अहम् I, अग्निम् fire, तीक्ष्णम् sharp, विषम् poison, अपः वा or the waters, भक्षयिष्ये shall swallow, प्रवेक्ष्यामि or shall enter, जीवितुम् to live, न तु शक्ष्यामि I shall not be able
entries.58.20: त्वम् you, दुःखिताम् sorrowing, अवमानिताम् slighted, माम् me, न अवजानीषे do not regard, ब्रह्मन् O brahmin, वृक्षस्य of a tree, अवज्ञया by the neglect, वृक्षजीविनः those who live by the tree, छिद्यन्ते are cut off
entries.58.21: भार्गव O Bhargava, राजर्षिः the royal sage, अवज्ञया with contempt, परिभूय च and having slighted me, मयि upon me, अवज्ञाम् disdain, प्रयुङ्क्ते हि does indeed practise, माम् me, बहु highly, न च मन्यते and does not esteem
entries.58.22: तस्याः her, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, कोपेन with wrath, अभिपरिप्लुतः wholly flooded, भार्गवः Bhargava, नहुषात्मजम् against the son of Nahusha, व्याहर्तुम् to speak, उपचक्राम began
entries.58.23: नाहुष O son of Nahusha, यस्मात् since, दुरात्मवान् evil-souled, त्वम् you, माम् me, अवजानीषे despise, परया by extreme, जरया old age, जीर्णः worn out, शैथिल्यम् decrepitude, उपयास्यसि you shall come to
entries.58.24: एवम् thus, दुहितरम् to his daughter, उक्त्वा having spoken, समाश्वास्य च and having comforted her, महायशाः of great renown, भार्गवः Bhargava, ब्रह्मर्षिः the brahmin sage, पुनः again, स्वम् his own, भवनम् abode, जगाम went to
entries.58.25: सूर्यसमानतेजाः of splendour equal to the sun, द्विजपुङ्गवाग्र्यः foremost among bulls of the twice-born, सः he, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, सुताम् his daughter, देवयानीम् Devayani, समाश्वास्य च and having comforted, नहुषात्मजाय upon the son of Nahusha, शापम् the curse, दत्त्वा च and having laid, पुनः again, ययौ went his way
entries.59.1: तदा then, ऊशनसम् Ushanas, क्रुद्धम् enraged, श्रुत्वा having heard, आर्तः stricken, नहुषात्मजः the son of Nahusha, परमिकाम् extreme, जराम् old age, प्राप्य having received, यदुम् to Yadu, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.59.2: यदो O Yadu, त्वम् you, धर्मज्ञः a knower of dharma, असि are, मदर्थम् for my sake, परमिकाम् this extreme, जराम् old age, प्रतिगृह्यताम् let it be taken over, पुत्र O son, महायशः O greatly renowned one, भोगैः in enjoyments, रंस्ये I would take delight
entries.59.3: नरर्षभ O bull among men, विषयेषु in the pleasures of sense, न तावत् not yet, कृतकृत्यः अस्मि am I satisfied, तदा then, कामम् my desire, अनुभूय having enjoyed, ततः thereafter, अहम् I, जराम् old age, प्राप्स्यामि shall take on
entries.59.4: यदुः Yadu, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, नरर्षभम् to the bull among men, प्रत्युवाच replied, ते your, दयितः beloved, पुत्रः son, पूरुः Puru, जराम् the old age, वै indeed, प्रतिगृह्णातु let him take over
entries.59.5: पार्थिव O king, अहम् I, अर्थेषु from your favours, सन्निकर्षात् च and from your presence, बहिष्कृतः have been shut out, राजन् O king, कः who, सह together with you, भोजनम् food, अश्नाति eats, वै indeed, प्रतिगृह्णातु let him take it over
entries.59.6: राजा the king, तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, अथ then, पूरुम् to Puru, अब्रवीत् said, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, इयम् this, जरा old age, मदर्थम् for my sake, प्रतिगृह्यताम् let it be taken over
entries.59.7: नाहुषेण by the son of Nahusha, एवम् thus, उक्तः तु addressed, पूरुः Puru, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, अब्रवीत् said, धन्यः अस्मि I am blessed, अनुगृहीतः अस्मि I am favoured, तव your, शासने in the command, स्थितः अस्मि I stand
entries.59.8: नाहुषः the son of Nahusha, पूरोः of Puru, वचनम् the word, आज्ञाय having learnt, परया with the utmost, मुदा joy, अतुलम् unmatched, प्रहर्षम् delight, लेभे obtained, ताम् that, जराम् old age, सङ्क्रामयच्च and transferred to him
entries.59.9: ततः then, सः that, राजा king, तरुणः young again, सहस्रशः by the thousand, यज्ञान् sacrifices, प्राप्य having attained, बहुवर्षसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, मेदिनीम् the earth, पालयामास ruled
entries.59.10: अथ then, दीर्घस्य कालस्य after a long time, राजा the king, अथ then, पूरुम् to Puru, अब्रवीत् said, पुत्र O son, जराम् the old age, आनयस्व bring back, मे to me, न्यासम् the deposit, निर्यातयस्व restore
entries.59.11: पुत्र O son, मया by me, न्यासभूता as a trust, त्वयि upon you, जरा the old age, सङ्क्रामिता was transferred, तस्मात् therefore, ताम् that, जराम् old age, प्रतिग्रहीष्यामि I shall take back, व्यथाम् distress, मा कृथाः make not
entries.59.12: महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, शासनस्य of my command, प्रतिग्रहात् for your acceptance, प्रीतः च अस्मि I am pleased, प्रीतियुक्तः filled with affection, अहम् I, त्वां च you, नराधिपम् as ruler of men, अभिषेक्ष्यामि shall consecrate
entries.59.13: नहुषात्मजः the son of Nahusha, ययातिः Yayati, सुतम् his son, पूरुम् Puru, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having addressed, राजा the king, क्रुद्धः enraged, देवयानीसुतम् to the son of Devayani, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच ह spoke
entries.59.14: दुरासदः hard to approach, पुत्ररूपः in the form of a son, त्वम् you, मया by me, राक्षसः a rakshasa, जातः have been begotten, यत् in that, मम my, आज्ञाम् command, प्रतिहंसि you strike down, प्रजार्थे in the matter of offspring, विफलः barren, भव be
entries.59.15: यस्मात् since, गुरुभूतम् who am as your preceptor, पितरम् your father, माम् me, त्वम् you, अवमन्यसे you slight, त्वम् you, दारुणान् dreadful, राक्षसान् rakshasas, यातुधानान् and yatudhanas, जनयिष्यसि shall beget
entries.59.16: दुर्मतेः of the evil-minded one, वंशे in the line, सोमकुलोत्पन्ने sprung from the race of Soma, न तु स्थास्यति it shall not stand, भवतः your, वंशः अपि line too, तुल्यः like yourself, दुर्विनीतः ill-behaved, भविष्यति shall be
entries.59.17: राजर्षिः the royal sage, राज्यविवर्धनम् increaser of the realm, पूरुम् Puru, तम् him, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having addressed, अभिषेकेण with consecration, सम्पूज्य having honoured, आश्रमम् the hermitage, प्रविवेश ह entered
entries.59.18: ततः then, महता after a long, कालेन time, दिष्टान्तम् the appointed end, उपजग्मिवान् having attained, नहुषात्मजः the son of Nahusha, राजा king, ययातिः Yayati, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, सङ्गतः went
entries.59.19: महायशाः of great renown, पूरुः Puru, महता by great, धर्मेण righteousness, वृतः encompassed, काशिराज्ये in the kingdom of Kashi, पुरवरे in the best of cities, प्रतिष्ठाने at Pratishthana, तत् that, राज्यम् realm, चकार governed
entries.59.20: यदुः तु and Yadu, राजवंशबहिष्कृतः cast out of the royal line, दुर्गे in the fastness, क्रौञ्चवने in the Krauncha wood, पुरे in the city, सहस्रशः by the thousand, यातुधानान् yatudhanas, जनयामास begot
entries.59.21: एषः this, ऊशनसा by Ushanas, मुक्तः loosed, शापोत्सर्गः laying of a curse, ययातिना by Yayati, क्षत्रधर्मेण by the law of the kshatriya, धारितः was borne, यत् whereas, निमिश्च Nimi, न चक्षमे did not forbear
entries.59.22: सौम्य O gentle one, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, सर्वकारिणाम् of those who act in all things, दर्शनम् the view, ते to you, आख्यातम् has been told, यथा so that, नृगे in the case of Nriga, दोषः the fault, न स्यात् may not arise, अनुवर्तामहे let us so conform
entries.59.23: इति thus, चन्द्रतुल्यानने of face like the moon, रामे when Rama, कथयति was speaking, तदानीम् then, व्योम the sky, प्रविरलतरतारम् its stars grown very thin, जज्ञे became, पूर्वा the eastern, दिक् quarter, अरुणकिरणरक्ता reddened by the rays of dawn, कुसुमरसविमुक्तम् steeped in the juice of flowers, आकुण्ठितम् इव as though dyed, वस्त्रम् a garment, बभौ चैव and appeared
entries.60.1: तदा then, एवम् thus, संवदतोः as they conversed, तयोः of those two, रामलक्ष्मणयोः Rama and Lakshmana, वासन्तिकी of the spring, निशा the night, प्राप्ता came on, न शीता neither cold, न च घर्मदा nor bringing heat
entries.60.2: ततः then, विमले in the clear, प्रभाते dawn, कृतपौर्वाह्णिकक्रियः having performed the morning rites, पौरकार्यवित् knowing the business of the citizens, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, दर्शनम् the audience, अभिचक्राम proceeded to
entries.60.3: ततः then, सुमन्त्रः तु and Sumantra, आगम्य having come, राघवम् to Raghava, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, राजन् O king, एते these, तापसाः ascetics, प्रतिहताः held back, द्वारि at the gate, तिष्ठन्ति are standing
entries.60.4: महाराज O great king, नरव्याघ्र O tiger among men, यमुनातीरवासिनः dwellers on the bank of the Yamuna, महर्षयः the great sages, भार्गवच्यवनं चैव Chyavana of the line of Bhrigu, पुरस्कृत्य having set at their head, प्रीयमाणाः well disposed, कृतत्वराः in haste, ते of you, दर्शनम् an audience, चोदयन्ति press for
entries.60.5: धर्मवित् the knower of dharma, रामः Rama, तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रोवाच said, महाभागाः the greatly blessed, भार्गवप्रमुखाः headed by Bhargava, द्विजाः the twice-born, प्रवेश्यन्ताम् let them be shown in
entries.60.6: द्वाःस्थः the doorkeeper, राज्ञः तु of the king, आज्ञाम् the command, पुरस्कृत्य having set foremost, मूर्ध्नि upon his head, कृताञ्जलिः with joined palms, तदा then, सुदुरासदान् most unapproachable, तापसान् the ascetics, प्रवेशयामास ushered in
entries.60.7: तत्र there, स्वतेजसा with their own splendour, दीप्यमानम् blazing, महात्मनाम् of the great-souled, तापसानाम् ascetics, समधिकम् rather more than, शतम् a hundred, राजभवनम् the royal palace, प्रविष्टम् entered
entries.60.8: ते those, द्विजाः brahmins, सर्वतीर्थाम्बुसत्कृतैः hallowed with the waters of all sacred fords, पूर्णकलशैः with brimming jars, फलमूलं च and fruit and root, गृहीत्वा having taken, रामस्य to Rama, बहु in abundance, अभ्याहरन् presented
entries.60.9: रामः Rama, प्रीतिपुरस्कृतः filled with pleasure, तत् that, सर्वम् all, सर्वाणि all, तीर्थोदकानि the waters of the fords, विविधानि various, फलानि च and fruits, प्रतिगृह्य तु having received
entries.60.10: महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, सर्वान् एव all, महामुनीन् the great sages, उवाच च and addressed, इमानि these, आसनमुख्यानि foremost of seats, यथार्हम् as befits each, उपविश्यताम् let them be taken
entries.60.11: रामस्य of Rama, भाषितम् the speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, सर्वे एव all, महर्षयः the great sages, ते they, रुचिराख्यासु beautiful to look upon, काञ्चनीषु golden, बृसीषु upon the mats of kusha grass, निषेदुः sat down
entries.60.12: परपुरञ्जयः conqueror of the cities of foes, राघवः Raghava, तत्र there, उपविष्टान् seated, ऋषीन् the sages, दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्रयतः reverent, प्राञ्जलिः with joined palms, भूत्वा having become, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
entries.60.13: वः your, आगमनकार्यम् the business of your coming, किम् what is it, समाहितः with full attention, किम् what, करोमि shall I do, अहम् I, महर्षीणाम् by the great sages, आज्ञाप्यः am to be commanded, सर्वकामकरः doer of all you desire, सुखम् readily
entries.60.14: इदम् this, सकलम् entire, राज्यं च kingdom, हृदि in my heart, स्थितम् abiding, जीवितं च and my life, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, मे my, द्विजार्थम् is for the brahmins, एतत् this, सत्यम् is the truth, वः to you, ब्रवीमि I declare
entries.60.15: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, यमुनातीरवासिनाम् dwellers on the bank of the Yamuna, उग्रतपसाम् of fierce austerity, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, महान् a great, साधुकारः cry of approval, अभूत् arose
entries.60.16: महता with great, हर्षेण joy, वृताः filled, ते those, महात्मानः great-souled ones, ऊचुश्च and said, नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, भुवि on earth, तव एव in you alone, उपपन्नम् is this fitting, न अन्यतः and in no other
entries.60.17: राजन् O king, बहवः many, महाबलाः mighty, पार्थिवाः kings, अतिक्रान्ताः have passed away, कार्यस्य of the task, गौरवम् the weight, मत्वा having considered, प्रतिज्ञाम् such a pledge, न अभ्यरोचयन् they did not care to make
entries.60.18: त्वया by you, पुनः on the other hand, ब्राह्मणगौरवात् out of regard for brahmins, कारणम् the reason, अनवेक्ष्य हि without even looking into, इयम् this, प्रतिज्ञा pledge, कृता has been made, ततश्च and therefore, कर्ता हि असि you will indeed perform it, अत्र herein, न संशयः there is no doubt, महाभयात् from a great terror, ऋषीन् the sages, त्रातुम् to deliver, त्वम् you, अर्हसि are able
